title: Cisco Catalyst C1300-24XTS Review A Neat 24-port 10GbE Switch
gist: STH reviews the Cisco Catalyst C1300-24XTS, a 1U switch with 12x 10GBase-T and 12x SFP+ (not combo) ports that has run without issue for months in their lab. The excerpt covers hardware only; notable limitation is a single AC input with no redundant power.

insights.claim: The Cisco Catalyst C1300-24XTS offers 24 independent 10GbE ports split into 12 10GBase-T ports and 12 SFP+ cages, and these are not combo jacks.
insights.speaker: Rohit Kumar
insights.so_what: Targets SMB/edge buyers with mixed copper servers and fiber storage, competing in the affordable 10GbE switch segment.
insights.quote: A question we often see about switches with SFP+ and 10Gbase-T is whether they are combo jacks, these are not.

insights.claim: Cisco spread the 12 SFP+ cages into three banks of four, which makes inserting optics and DACs easier and helps cooling.
insights.speaker: Rohit Kumar
insights.so_what: Small design choices on thermal/serviceability differentiate commodity switches.
insights.locator: Next to those are twelve SFP+

insights.claim: STH ran the C1300-24XTS for months without issue before publishing, and considers the 24-port model the standout of the C1300 family it has tested (16XTS, 12XS, 12XT-2X, 8FP-2G).
insights.speaker: Rohit Kumar
insights.so_what: Signals reliability in Cisco's lower-cost Catalyst 1300 line aimed at SMB networking.
insights.quote: it has been running without issue for months

insights.claim: The C1300-24XTS is a full-width 1U metal chassis (444.3 x 273 x 43.94mm, 4.2kg) with a dedicated 1GbE out-of-band management port separate from the console and data ports.
insights.speaker: Rohit Kumar
insights.so_what: Out-of-band management at this tier is a feature typically reserved for pricier gear.
insights.locator: The Cisco Catalyst C1300-24XTS is a 1U

insights.claim: The switch has only a single AC power input, so A+B redundant power requires an external automatic transfer switch PDU.
insights.speaker: Rohit Kumar
insights.so_what: Lack of redundant PSU limits suitability for critical datacenter roles, keeping it in SMB/edge.
insights.quote: There is no redundant power input here
insights.locator: Moving to the rear, there is
